title: Use {provider} in ChatGPT
sub: ChatGPT reaches {provider} through a custom MCP server, which you add on chatgpt.com on a paid plan.
steps: Connect {provider} to MCPEmails with the steps above.
On chatgpt.com, open Plugins, Personal, click Add, then Add custom MCP server.
Name it MCPEmails, paste https://mcpemails.com/api/mcp under Connection, choose OAuth, confirm, click Create as a plugin and sign in to MCPEmails.
In a chat, type @ and pick MCPEmails. Do it again when a follow-up needs your mail.
blogLink: How to connect ChatGPT to your email
faqA: Yes, once {provider} is connected to MCPEmails. On chatgpt.com, add a custom MCP server with the URL https://mcpemails.com/api/mcp and OAuth sign-in. That needs a paid plan: OpenAI's help page names Business and Enterprise/Edu for full support and Pro for read-only tools. ChatGPT gets only the access you approve, and your mail is fetched live, never stored.
directorySub: ChatGPT reaches {provider} through the Any Mailbox app from MCPEmails.
directorySteps: Connect {provider} to MCPEmails with the steps above.
Open Any Mailbox in the ChatGPT app directory and click Connect.
Sign in to MCPEmails and approve the access you want ChatGPT to have.
